lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We've got the latest location for Volt Jr.
Where is it?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Somewhere with thick vegetation and a thriving ecosystem.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Volt Jr. is primarily powered by solar energy.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: If it's under that dense canopy, there won't be enough sunlight for it to get a sufficient charge.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: However, moving to that location

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: shows that Volt Jr. must be primarily motivated by a desire to consume more food.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Having said that, Volt Jr. technically does not require any sustenance to operate.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: That leads us to believe that these latest movements

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: are a result of instinct.
Instinct?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I'm sure you're wondering what instinct a robot could possibly have, but

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: we may have unknowingly managed to reproduce instincts into a mechanical device.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: If this turns out to be true,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: this is an astonishing revelation.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: It means we're one step closer to creating actual life.
Tell me the location.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I see that you are determined.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I like that.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I'll send you the coordinates shortly.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Whether you capture or eliminate Volt Jr. is a decision I leave to you.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: ... On second thought,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: capture it alive

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: if at all possible.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We hardly want such valuable research to go to waste.
Okay.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Looking forward to you bringing me good news.
